title: Northbound Loop 20 traffic shifts to temporary detour at Loop Boulevard for months
excerpt: Northbound Loop 20 traffic between Loop Boulevard and International Boulevard moves to a temporary bypass, expected to stay in place four to six months while a new northbound frontage road is built, according to KGNS.
content:
Northbound Loop 20 traffic between Loop Boulevard and International Boulevard is shifting to a temporary detour, according to KGNS.

Crews will begin by painting lane markings and moving concrete barriers along the northbound main lanes, according to KGNS. The closure is scheduled from 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. on Monday, November 2, as stated in the KGNS report.

Northbound Loop 20 traffic from Loop Boulevard will be rerouted onto a temporary bypass just south of the former UISD food kitchen on Loop 20, then reconnect to Loop 20 near International Boulevard, according to KGNS. Residents of the Loop subdivision will still be able to reach their homes.

The detour is expected to remain in place for four to six months while a new northbound frontage road is built, according to KGNS.

Sources:

  • KGNS, "Loop Boulevard traffic to Loop 20 moves to temporary detour," November 1, 2026
